paper_title: Mapping the Minds of LLMs A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM
caption_used: Convergence ratio (gamma_C) as a function of the number of few-shot examples, comparing Correct and Incorrect reasoning outcomes. The chart shows grouped bars for each shot count (0 through 4), with Incorrect outcomes in blue (dotted pattern) and Correct outcomes in red (diagonal stripes). For Correct outcomes, gamma_C remains relatively stable at approximately 0.6 across 0 through 2 shots before declining to roughly 0.53 at 3 shots and approximately 0.28 at 4 shots. For Incorrect outcomes, gamma_C decreases from about 0.25 at 0 shots to around 0.05 at 2 shots. The convergence gap between Correct and Incorrect narrows progressively, with the most significant narrowing occurring between 2 and 3 shots, where Incorrect gamma_C rises slightly to approximately 0.10 while Correct gamma_C begins its decline.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е групирана стълбовидна и представя съотношението на конвергенция γ_C като функция от броя few-shot примери, като сравнява два изхода на разсъждение, означени в легендата като „Incorrect“ и „Correct“. Категориите са по хоризонталната ос, етикетирана „Number of Shots“, и включват дискретни стойности 0, 1, 2, 3 и 4, подредени във възходящ ред; за всяка категория има по два съседни стълба (групиране по категория). Вертикалната ос е етикетирана „γ_C“ и използва линейна скала с маркировки приблизително при 0.0, 0.2, 0.4 и 0.6 (видим горен диапазон малко над 0.6); единици не са посочени. Стълбовете за „Incorrect“ са в син цвят с точкова шарка, а за „Correct“ са в тъмночервен/магента цвят с диагонални щрихи, като легендата е разположена в горната част на графиката. По приблизителни визуални стойности „Correct“ е около 0.61 при 0 shots и около 0.61 при 1 shot, около 0.54 при 2 shots, около 0.52–0.53 при 3 shots и около 0.27–0.28 при 4 shots, докато „Incorrect“ е около 0.24–0.25 при 0 shots, около 0.20–0.21 при 1 shot и около 0.05 при 2, 3 и 4 shots. Няма допълнително подчертаване на конкретни стълбове извън различните цветове и шарки, и не се виждат линии на грешка.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the convergence ratio, labeled on the vertical axis as \(\gamma_C\), across different numbers of few-shot examples while separating outcomes into two categories shown in the legend: “Incorrect” and “Correct.” The horizontal axis contains the categorical shot counts labeled “Number of Shots,” ordered from 0 to 4 in ascending order, and the bars are displayed in side-by-side groups for each shot count. The vertical axis uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, and 0.6, spanning a visible range from about 0.0 up to slightly above 0.6. For each shot count, two bars are shown: the “Incorrect” bar is blue with a dotted hatch pattern and the “Correct” bar is dark red/magenta with diagonal stripe hatching; both have dark outlines. Approximate bar heights are as follows: at 0 shots, Incorrect is about 0.24 and Correct about 0.61; at 1 shot, Incorrect about 0.21 and Correct about 0.61; at 2 shots, Incorrect about 0.05 and Correct about 0.55; at 3 shots, Incorrect about 0.05 and Correct about 0.53; and at 4 shots, Incorrect about 0.05 and Correct about 0.27. The chart uses grouped (not stacked) bars with consistent spacing and no additional annotations or visual emphasis beyond color/hatching and the legend.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt das Konvergenzverhältnis γ_C in Abhängigkeit von der Anzahl der Few-shot-Beispiele („Number of Shots“) dar und unterscheidet dabei zwischen den beiden Ergebnisarten „Incorrect“ und „Correct“. Auf der horizontalen Achse stehen die Kategorien der Shot-Anzahl in aufsteigender Reihenfolge von 0 bis 4 (diskrete Kategorien). Die vertikale Achse ist mit γ_C beschriftet und zeigt eine lineare Skala mit markierten Ticks bei 0.0, 0.2, 0.4 und 0.6 (der dargestellte Wertebereich reicht visuell bis etwas über 0.6). Für jede Shot-Kategorie sind zwei nebeneinander gruppierte Balken dargestellt: ein blauer Balken mit Punktmuster für „Incorrect“ und ein magentafarbener Balken mit diagonaler Schraffur für „Correct“, wie in der Legende oben angegeben. Bei 0 Shots liegt „Incorrect“ bei ungefähr 0.24 und „Correct“ bei ungefähr 0.61; bei 1 Shot liegt „Incorrect“ bei etwa 0.21 und „Correct“ ebenfalls bei etwa 0.61; bei 2 Shots liegt „Incorrect“ bei etwa 0.05 und „Correct“ bei ungefähr 0.55; bei 3 Shots liegt „Incorrect“ bei etwa 0.05 und „Correct“ bei ungefähr 0.53; bei 4 Shots liegt „Incorrect“ bei etwa 0.05 und „Correct“ bei ungefähr 0.27. Eine besondere visuelle Hervorhebung einzelner Balken (z. B. Rahmen, Marker oder Annotationen) ist nicht erkennbar; die Anordnung folgt der Shot-Anzahl von links nach rechts.
